CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER
16- 6795

H.B.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai.
16th August, 1939.

My dear Givens,

With reference to our conversation on the
subject of W. F. CARMAN (the American who was in
communication with MINISTER), I send you herewith a
note on this man's activities in Hongkong. Please
regard this as most confidential and for your own
information only. He has been definitely identified
as having been in 1931 a representative of the Phelps
Dodge Corporation, an American copper producing com-
pany. He was in China in 1939.

Yours sincerely,
[Signature]

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
SHANGHAI.

1939年8月16日。

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

关于我们就 W. F. CARMAN（即与部长 [MINISTER] 有联系的美国人）一事进行的谈话，现随函附上关于此人在香港活动情况的笔记。请将此视为绝密，仅供你个人参考。已确证他于1931年曾担任美国铜业生产公司 Phelps Dodge Corporation 的代表。他于1939年在中国。

此致
敬礼，
[签名]

T. P. Givens 先生，
上海。

Section 2, Special Branch
CONFIDENTIAL REPORT
File No. C-4727
Date June 25, 1935

Subject Re. William F. Carman.

Made by D.S.I. Coyne Forwarded by [Signature] D.S.I.

Further to my report dated June 19, 1935, concerning
the arrival in Shanghai of William F. Carman, from informat-
ion since obtained, it does not appear probable that he is
the person referred to as "Walt Carmon" in the Special Branch
report on the activities of Miss Irene Weitemeyer.

It has been learned that when Carman made enquiries
regarding ships leaving for Hongkong, he asked whether any
would call at Formosa, as he had been seventeen years in
China and had not yet visited that island. No ship
following that route being due to leave, Carman departed on
the s.s. "President Pierce" on June 22, 1935.

The fact that he compiled a detailed report on the
survey of the mineral resources of China, would indicate that
he has been in the country for some time, probably, as stated
by him, in the capacity of a mining engineer. That this
report was forwarded to the Chairman of the American Economic
Mission tends to support his statement that he was working
on behalf of that body.

Concerning K. C. Wong, with whom Carman frequently
communicated, it has been ascertained that this person
came to Shanghai about two years ago and has since been
engaged in the export of porcelain ware. He resides with
his wife and child at 4 Yu Ching Lee, Thorne Road, and has
business premises at 792, North Szechuen Road.

Pending the receipt of further information regarding
Carman, enquiries with reference to Wong will be discontinued.

日期 1935年6月25日

主题：关于 William F. Carman。

由副督察长（D.S.I.）Coyne 撰写，由 [签名] 副督察长转呈。

继我于1935年6月19日关于 William F. Carman 抵达上海的报告之后，根据此后获得的情报，他似乎不太可能是特别支部关于 Irene Weitemeyer 小姐活动报告中提到的“Walt Carmon”。

据悉，Carman 在查询前往香港的船只时，曾询问是否有船停靠台湾（Formosa），因为他已在中国十七年，但尚未访问过该岛。由于没有沿该航线行驶的船只即将离港，Carman 于1935年6月22日乘坐“皮尔斯总统号”（s.s. "President Pierce"）轮船离开。

事实上，他编制了一份关于中国矿产资源勘察的详细报告，这表明他已在中国停留了一段时间，可能如他所述，是以采矿工程师的身份。该报告已转交给美国经济代表团主席，这一事实倾向于支持他代表该机构工作的说法。

关于经常与 Carman 联络的 K. C. Wong，经查实，此人约两年前来到上海，此后一直从事瓷器出口业务。他与妻子和孩子居住在索恩路（Thorne Road）余庆里4号，营业地点位于北四川路792号。

在收到有关 Carman 的进一步信息之前，将停止对 Wong 的调查。

（左侧批注：）
12月2日

pages.en:
William F. Carman arrived in Hong Kong from
Shanghai in the S.S. 'President Pierce' on ....... He
is an American citizen bearing U.S. Passport No. ...,
issued at Washington in September, 19.., bearing a
transit visa for travel to Canton given at H.M. Consulate-
General, Shanghai.

He remained in Hong Kong two days and one night,
and stayed at the Kowloon Hotel. He collected several
letters from the American Express Co., immediately on
his arrival and later was seen to post one himself. He
left for Canton by the night boat on 26.8.56.

While in Canton, he was kept under observation
by detectives from the Public Safety Bureau. He stayed
several days at the New Asia Hotel and then removed to
No.4, Hui Fa Village, the residence of an American named
G. Edward Lyon. He also visited an unidentified member of
the American Foundation Fees Committee of the Ling Nam
University.

At present there is not much information available
concerning the Man Lyon, except that last year he was prac-
tising in Canton as an Attorney-at-Law, but has since
given that up and has been trying to run a dance hall. He
is not considered a desirable character by the Canton
Police.

On 19.8.56, Carman flew to Nanning where he has
been ever since. It is reported that he is acting as
some sort of financial advisor to the Kwangsi Government,
and that he is working in the Economic Commission of that
Province, but he has not been kept under observation
there, and it is not known exactly what he is doing.
pages.zh:
William F. Carman 于.......乘坐“皮尔斯总统号”（S.S. 'President Pierce'）从上海抵达香港。他是美国公民，持有美国护照第...号，该护照于19..年9月在华盛顿签发，并持有由英国驻上海总领事馆签发的前往广州的过境签证。

他在香港停留了两天一夜，住在九龙酒店。他抵达后立即从美国运通公司领取了几封信件，随后被人看到亲自寄出了一封信。他于8月26日晚乘夜船前往广州。

在广州期间，他受到公安局侦探的监视。他在新亚酒店住了几天，然后搬至惠福村4号，这是一位名叫 G. Edward Lyon 的美国人的住所。他还拜访了岭南大学美国基金会费用委员会的一名身份不明的成员。

目前关于 Lyon 先生的信息不多，仅知去年他在广州从事律师职业，但此后已放弃该职业，一直试图经营一家舞厅。广州警方认为他不是一个受欢迎的人物。

1935年8月19日，Carman 飞往南宁，此后一直留在那里。据报道，他担任广西政府的某种财务顾问，并在该省经济委员会工作，但他在那里未受到监视，确切的工作内容尚不清楚。

CONFIDENTIAL
DRAWER

H.B.M. Consulate General,
Shanghai.

20th June 1935.

My dear Givens,

With reference to your report on W.F.
CARMON, handed to me by D.S. Coyne dated 19.6.35., I would
draw your attention to the S.B. report of November 14th
1934., on the activities of MISS IRENE WEITEMEYER, in which
the name "WALT CARMON" occurs as the Assistant Editor of the
"International Literature".

Although admittedly the possibilities
appear remote, I suppose that there is no chance that these
two men are in anyway related to or connected with one
another.

Yours Sincerely,
[Signature]

T.P. Givens Esq.,
Special Branch,
S.M.P.

（批：S2/ Could further inquiries be also made
about the where abouts of Bruno Schwartz's mother?
Schwartz is an able newspaperman. Would he have
come here on some commission for the Reds?
Jdg 20 JUNE 1935）

1935年6月20日。

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

关于 D.S. Coyne 于1935年6月19日转交予你的关于 W.F. CARMON 的报告，我想提请你注意1934年11月14日特别支部关于 IRENE WEITEMEYER 小姐活动的报告，其中出现了“WALT CARMON”的名字，其身份为《国际文学》（"International Literature"）的助理编辑。

虽然承认这种可能性看来微乎其微，但我猜想这两人之间没有任何亲属或关联关系。

此致
敬礼，
[签名]

T.P. Givens 先生，
特别支部，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

（批注：S2/ 是否也可以进一步调查 Bruno Schwartz 母亲的下落？Schwartz 是一位能干的新闻工作者。他是否会受红色分子委托来到这里？

Section 2, Special Branch Squad
REPORT
Date June 19, 19 35.

Subject Re. William F. Carman.

Made by D.S.I. Coyne Forwarded by [Signature] D.I

I have to report that enquiries have been made concerning
William F. Carman, who endeavoured to get into communication
with Leon Minster.
Carman arrived in Shanghai on June 2, 1935, from Canton,
having travelled from Hongkong aboard the s.s. "Empress of
Asia." His passport, No. 2607 issued at Washington on
September 18, 1934, describes Carman as being an engineer,
age 42, a resident of New York. On his Passport Office
Declaration Form he named as reference Dr. James Henry,
Lingnan University, Canton, with whom he is believed to have
stayed whilst in Canton. He declared that his reason for
visiting China was to attend the conference of the American
Economic Mission, and that he would remain in Shanghai for
two or three days.
Since his arrival he has stayed at the Palace Hotel,
occupying room 411, in which he had all meals consumed on
the premises.
Since his arrival he has almost daily had a stenographer
typing in his room during the morning, and he frequently
visited the Park Hotel, Bubbling Well Road, and the Royal
Hotel, Range Road. His evenings are spent in bars on North
Szechuen Road frequented by American sailors, and in addition
he spends much time at the San To Massage and Turkish Bath
House, off North Szechuen Road, near Boone Road.
Nothing to indicate that Carman was officially connected
with the American Economic Mission can be found. The
members of the Mission stayed at the Park Hotel, and the
daily visits of Carman would suggest that he went there to
see some member of the Mission. On June 17, he sent two

兹报告，已就 William F. Carman 进行调查，此人曾试图与 Leon Minster 建立联系。
Carman 于1935年6月2日从广州抵达上海，此前从香港乘坐“亚洲皇后号”（s.s. "Empress of Asia"）轮船旅行。他的护照第2607号于1934年9月18日在华盛顿签发，描述 Carman 为工程师，42岁，纽约居民。在他的护照申报表中，他列出的证明人是广州岭南大学的 James Henry 博士，据信他在广州期间曾与该博士同住。他声明访华原因是参加美国经济代表团的会议，并将在上海停留两三天。
自抵达以来，他一直住在皇宫饭店（Palace Hotel），占用411房间，所有餐食均在店内食用。
自抵达以来，他几乎每天上午都有一名速记员在其房间内打字，他还频繁访问静安寺路的派克饭店（Park Hotel）和兰心大戏院附近的皇家饭店（Royal Hotel）。他的夜晚时光消磨在北四川路美国水手常去的酒吧里，此外，他还花大量时间在靠近宝山路（Boone Road）的北四川路旁的三多按摩土耳其浴室（San To Massage and Turkish Bath House）。
未发现任何迹象表明 Carman 与美国经济代表团有官方联系。代表团成员住在派克饭店，Carman 的日常访问表明他去那里是为了会见代表团的某位成员。6月17日，他寄出了两
